psychological_meaning: Turmeric, with its warm and earthy yellow-orange hue, evokes feelings of warmth, vitality, and optimism. It is often associated with energy, creativity, and a sense of adventure. This color can inspire confidence and encourage a positive outlook, while also promoting a sense of comfort and well-being.
